298469.overview: 100 players compete in unique, funny games. Last-place finishers get eliminated each round. Don't finish last to stay in. Last contestant standing wins $1,000,000.

284581.title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for the Throne
284581.overview: To the empire, Prince Arnold is one big joke, a completely inept prince outshone by his more talented twin, Leonard. But in secret, Arnold operates as Silver, one of only five magic-wielding SS-rank adventurers on the continent. As the bloody battle for the throne intensifies after the crown prince’s death, Arnold pulls the strings from the shadows to crown his twin emperor to his own advantage.

218642.title: My Senior Brother is Too Steady
218642.overview: After being reborn in the ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou becomes a minor cultivator. His only dream is to live a long life as a cultivator. In order to survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma—killing inevitably leads to feuds. Thus, he always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters his mystical abilities. Li Changshou originally plans to remain hidden and safe in the mountain. There, he is supposed to cultivate until he ascends to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master seems to think that their lives are too peaceful. He takes in a junior sister…

288873.title: Gladiator in the Theater
288873.overview: Meng Jinfu, an unremarkable teen from a humble background, uses his perseverance to rise from an obscure opera student to a prominent figure in Beijing’s traditional opera scene.

253372.title: The Institute
253372.overview: When 14 year old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won’t last, as his story and Luke’s are destined to collide.

198178.title: Wonder Man
198178.overview: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

294487.title: Remnants of Gold
294487.overview: Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

126437.title: Aoashi
126437.overview: Ashito Aoi is a young, aspiring soccer player from a backwater town in Japan. His hopes of getting into a high school with a good soccer club are dashed when he causes an incident during a critical match for his team, which results in their loss and elimination from the tournament. Nevertheless, he catches the eye of someone important who happened to be visiting from Tokyo. How will things turn out for Ashito?

314054.title: Red River
314054.overview: After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future.

247522.title: Tires
247522.overview: At his father's auto shop, a hapless manager strives to improve customer service and drive profits while keeping his troublemaking cousin in line.

297438.title: Akane-banashi
297438.overview: As a child, Akane witnesses a shocking event during her father's career-defining show. Now in high school, she vows to reach the art's highest rank.

284736.title: Boston Blue
284736.overview: NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a job with the Boston PD and is paired with Detective Lena Silver, part of a law enforcement family comprised of District Attorney Mae Silver, Police Superintendent Sarah Silver, rookie cop Jonah Silver and Rev. Edwin Peters. Reagan hopes to reconnect with his son, Sean, in Boston.

311648.title: Make Me Tremble
311648.overview: Raised in a conservative household and working at a marketing firm, a woman’s orderly life is upended when she meets the daring CEO of an adult product company. As their worlds collide, they challenge each other’s beliefs and discover unexpected ways to grow together.

331216.title: 同じゼミの染谷さんがセクシー女優だった話。

323447.title: NOUR
323447.overview: When bizarre fires expose a multi-generational curse, two police officers uncover buried secrets while love and corruption threaten to consume them.

334707.title: FX's American Horror Story Official Podcast
334707.overview: Go deeper into the terrifying world of American Horror Story: 13 as each new episode is unpacked through discussions of its biggest twists, returning characters, hidden details and the stories behind the season’s latest nightmares.

284833.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
284833.overview: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

110316.title: Alice in Borderland
110316.overview: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.

334201.title: Kaiju No. 8 Original Short Anime "Narumi's Week at Work"
334201.overview: An official original short anime spin-off of Kaiju No. 8, spotlighting Gen Narumi — captain of the Defense Force's First Division and hailed as Japan's strongest anti-kaiju fighter. Overwhelmingly powerful and utterly insufferable about it, Narumi skips meetings, dodges paperwork, and spends every spare second gaming online. But even the strongest man on earth gets humbled now and then by the most unexpected counterattacks. A four-episode bite-size comedy about the strongest man's anything-but-peaceful everyday life.

295434.title: Kamen Rider ZEZTZ
295434.overview: Baku Yorozu is an an ordinary young man living an uneventful life. But with the power of lucid dreaming, he turns into an unstoppable secret agent. In the dream world, there appears the Nightmare, a monstrous figure bent on bringing bad dreams into the real world. While the line between dream and reality breaks, Baku acquires a mysterious belt, transforming himself into Kamen Rider ZEZTZ! Make your dream come true. Good luck!

226174.title: Matlock
226174.overview: After achieving success in her younger years, the brilliant septuagenarian Madeline Matlock rejoins the workforce at a prestigious law firm where she uses her unassuming demeanor and wily tactics to win cases and expose corruption from within. Inspired by the classic television series of the same name.

323411.title: The Vampire Lestat
323411.overview: The Vampire Lestat goes on tour while being haunted by "muses" from his past. As the band's popularity grows, so does Lestat's influence over vampires & humans alike, leaving others to contend with Lestat's power in the face of the Great Conversion.

63726.title: Alone
63726.overview: Hardcore survivalists are put by themselves in the Vancouver Island wilderness, without camera crews, teams, or producers – on a single mission to stay alive for as long as possible.

253811.title: Tougen Anki
253811.overview: After a Momotaro assassin suddenly kills his adoptive father, Shiki vows to avenge him. But first, he must learn to control his newly awakened Oni blood.

315054.title: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration
315054.overview: An arranged marriage. Two complete strangers. One adorable romance! When cheerful noblewoman Elsa is suddenly wed to the reserved duke-to-be Julius, neither expects their political marriage to spark something more. As awkward misunderstandings, sweet gestures, and growing feelings pile up, these newlyweds discover that falling in love might be the easiest—and hardest—part of married life.

324502.title: Overgeared
324502.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can’t seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he’s leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

300030.title: Envy
300030.overview: Deprived of her mother's attention and love throughout her life, Seniha grows up with a deep sense of jealousy towards her older brother, Halit. For her beauty-obsessed mother, Seniha is the ugly duckling, completely unfit for her noble and wealthy family. Her older brother, Halit, is the opposite. He is her mother's pride in every sense. Halit attends the best schools and takes advantage of the family's resources. He becomes both the country's most successful lawyer and its most promiscuous bachelor. Seniha, however, sinks deeper and deeper into the depths of her sense of worthlessness. She never finished school, never married, and has practically become a servant in her own home. She has become, as her older brother calls her, "Miss Nobody.

293629.title: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers
293629.overview: The Demon World once plunged the Human World into terror. With the seal broken and hordes of Demon Soldiers launching an invasion, five young warriors rushed to humanity's rescue. They were called the Samurai Troopers, and now their battle begins anew!

289892.title: Helluva Boss
289892.overview: In Hell, imp Blitzø (the 'o' is silent) runs an assassin business targeting the world of the living, using a spell book borrowed from a prince of the underworld. With employees Moxxie, Millie, and Loona, they attempt to survive each other while keeping business afloat.

225171.title: Pluribus
225171.overview: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

79481.title: Fights Break Sphere
79481.overview: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

319938.title: KakuseiHunter Omegahorn
319938.overview:
In ancient times, gigantic creatures called "Mega Horn" ruled the Earth, but they were sealed away in items called "Egorgear" and disappeared. In modern times, humans have emerged using megaphone-like items called "Kakuseiki" to draw out the power of the Mega Horn sealed in the Egorgear. They've come to be known as "Hunters".

Shout the Flame, an explorer well-versed in ancient scripts one day discovers a Kakuseiki and an Egorgear on an altar of an ancient ruin. Confused by the "Omegahorn", which is different from the standard version, he sets the Egorgear in place and a giant horned beast named Enkaku appears! Seeing the qualities of a "king" in Shout's Ego, Enkaku demands to call himself "Captain Omegahorn" and fight alongside him, leading to a battle against a diverse cast of hunters wherever they go.

92611.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
92611.overview: RuPaul has made the trip across the pond in search of a queen with the most charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in all the land.

293060.title: A Date with Goddess
293060.overview: Five female celebrities search for love as men from across Hong Kong compete for a chance to date them. Through auditions and talent showcases, contestants aim to impress and earn the opportunity to connect with the "goddesses" in this romantic matchmaking journey.

329818.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Podcast
329818.overview: Join hosts Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton each week as they dive into every episode with exclusive interviews featuring the show's creators, cast, and crew.

67063.title: Hitori No Shita - The Outcast
67063.overview: Zhang Chulan leads a very common college student's life until he finds himself caught up in a terrible incident that happened in a small village. As he was walking through a graveyard, he is assaulted by zombies. Thinking that it was over for him, a mysterious girl carrying a sword suddenly saves him and disappears.

314360.title: YAGA
314360.overview: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

117488.title: Yellowjackets
117488.overview: This equal parts survival epic, psychological horror story and coming-of-age drama tells the saga of a team of wildly talented high school girls soccer players who become the (un)lucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the remote northern wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to savage clans, while also tracking the lives they’ve attempted to piece back together nearly 25 years later.

312929.title: Scent of the Wind
312929.overview: Set in the Meiji era, two young women who graduate from the same nursing school forge an unbreakable bond as they navigate the hardships of early modern medicine, working tirelessly alongside doctors while fighting to prove themselves in a changing Japan.

213562.title: Crystal Lake
213562.overview: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

11436.title: Bigg Boss
11436.overview: Your ‘Host and Dost’ Salman Khan is back! Brace for another high-octane season of the greatest reality show, serving entertainment and drama—all unfiltered!

327720.title: Kouman
327720.overview:
Kouman is an entertaining Iranian YouTube series hosted by Kourosh, Iman, and Mia, with new episodes released every Friday. The show is primarily focused on fun challenges and food tasting. In each episode, they engage in exciting competitions, blind taste tests, comparing cheap versus expensive items, and reviewing bizarre gadgets. With its humorous and friendly atmosphere, Kouman delivers hilarious moments for its audience, occasionally featuring travel vlogs to explore and taste local cuisines‌

12:00 PM (Tehran Time)‌

‌1:30 AM (Vancouver Time)

328570.title: Love Penalty
328570.overview: The relationship that began with suspicion became the most dangerous foul. The story of three people that begins the moment they cross the line they should have stopped at.

250295.title: Living Spectacles
250295.overview: A nature documentary produced by the China National Geographic Integrated Media Center. Approaching the Medog Forest, a rare primeval forest in China, generations of biologists risked death to sneak into this secret land. Here, you will feel the huge altitude difference. In half a day, you can travel from the alpine ice and snow belt to the tropical seasonal rainforest. In subsequent films, we will continue to go into unknown corners and explore the mysteries of nature.

333327.title: Till I See You
333327.overview:
Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

326991.title: A Trap Called Desire
326991.overview: Falsely accused of murder, a woman loses everything overnight. Determined to reclaim her stolen life, she uncovers a far-reaching conspiracy as she exposes hidden truths and confronts the powerful figures who sacrificed innocent lives to protect their own ambitions.

226415.title: Blood Red: Under the Moonlight
226415.overview: Luna, a girl searching for a cure for her curse of transforming into a maned wolf every full moon, is the daughter of Carol, who began secret genetic research funded by a pharmaceutical group to find a solution to her daughter's problem, the result of a relationship with a werewolf during her days as a Biology student at university.

251597.title: Bookish
251597.overview: Gabriel Book, proprietor of an antiquarian bookshop, relies on his vast collection to unravel baffling cases. He nurtures a group of lovable yet troubled individuals, providing informal protection and guidance.

275224.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
275224.overview: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

222176.title: Cat's Eyes
222176.overview: In 2023, Alexia, Tam and Sylia are reunited in the City of Light after many years apart. At the same time, a work of art that belonged to their father – who had died ten years earlier in a mysterious fire at his art gallery – reappears in a prestigious exhibition at the Eiffel Tower. The sisters decide to risk everything to steal the painting, in the hope that they will finally solve the mystery of what happened to their father.

279388.title: Pursuit of Jade
279388.overview: This drama follows Fan Changyu, a butcher’s daughter, and Xie Zheng, a fallen noble seeking revenge. Their fake marriage turns into true love, but war tears them apart. Determined, Fan Changyu wields her butcher’s knife on the battlefield, searching for justice and her husband. Meanwhile, Xie Zheng reclaims his title, fighting to protect his country and love. Reunited in battle, they stand together, defying fate, uncovering the truth, and returning home without forgetting their vows.

1999.title: The Comeback
1999.overview: For Valerie Cherish, no price is too high to pay for clinging to the spotlight. Desperate to revive her career, she agrees to star in a reality TV series, allowing cameras to follow her every move as she lands a part on a new network sitcom.

230424.title: Betty La Fea: The Story Continues
230424.overview: While an empowered and wiser Betty works hard on rebuilding her relationship with her teenage daughter Mila, her relationship with Armando begins to deteriorate, making her question if she made the right decision 20 years ago.

218342.title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
218342.overview: Five years after the death of schoolgirl Andie Bell, Pippa Fitz-Amobi sets out to uncover what really happened to her. Sal Singh, Andie's boyfriend, admitted to the murder before taking his own life, but Pip doesn't believe he's responsible and teams up with Sal's brother Ravi to uncover the truth. If Sal Singh isn't a murderer and the real killer is still out there, how far will they go to keep Pip from finding out the truth?

284419.title: Kuma - The Other Wife
284419.overview: Kuma: The Other Wife is a 2025 Turkish drama set in the rugged landscapes of eastern Turkey. When Ceylan — a young woman dreaming of independence — is wrongfully framed for murder, she is forced into a devastating fate: becoming the second wife, or "kuma," of Karan, the brother of the man she is accused of killing, and the man she loves. Trapped in a hostile household and fighting to prove her innocence, the series weaves together love, betrayal, tribal tradition, and emotional survival. Starring Aybüke Yılmaz and Emre Özmen.

331932.title: Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot
331932.overview: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

319037.title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
319037.overview: Seeking refuge in the mountains, a famous actor falls for a tea farmer, where love blooms between two vastly different worlds.

334653.title: The Split Up
334653.overview: For Manchester's elite, family firm Kishan Law are the go-to divorce lawyers. But amid the messiness of love, marriage and deception, the personal and professional will collide.

336376.title: True Crime : Casse du Louvre : Les secrets d’un incroyable braquage

333016.title: Outside
333016.overview: Going beyond the four walls, Outside is the latest spin-off from the Sidemen's smash-hit series Inside. A new group of content creators are thrown into the forest to battle for a prize of up to £1 million. With every comfort eating into the prize pot, they'll face brutal decisions, unpredictable challenges and plenty of Sidemen mischief as they fight to keep hold of the cash.

206647.title: Spectre
206647.overview: A cryptic message from Bond’s past sends him on a trail to uncover a sinister organization. While M battles political forces to keep the secret service alive, Bond peels back the layers of deceit to reveal the terrible truth behind SPECTRE.

36669.title: Die Another Day
36669.overview: James Bond is sent to investigate the connection between a North Korean terrorist and a diamond mogul, who is funding the development of an international space weapon.

710.title: GoldenEye
710.overview: When a powerful satellite system falls into the hands of Alec Trevelyan, AKA Agent 006, a former ally-turned-enemy, only James Bond can save the world from a dangerous space weapon that -- in one short pulse -- could destroy the earth! As Bond squares off against his former compatriot, he also battles Xenia Onatopp, an assassin who uses pleasure as her ultimate weapon.

10764.title: Quantum of Solace
10764.overview: Betrayed by Vesper, the woman he loved, 007 fights the urge to make his latest mission personal. Pursuing his determination to uncover the truth, Bond and M interrogate Mr. White, who reveals that the organization that blackmailed Vesper is far more complex and dangerous than anyone had imagined.

646.title: Dr. No
646.overview: Agent 007 battles mysterious Dr. No, a scientific genius bent on destroying the U.S. space program. As the countdown to disaster begins, Bond must go to Jamaica, where he encounters beautiful Honey Ryder, to confront a megalomaniacal villain in his massive island headquarters.

658.title: Goldfinger
658.overview: Special agent 007 comes face to face with one of the most notorious villains of all time, and now he must outwit and outgun the powerful tycoon to prevent him from cashing in on a devious scheme to raid Fort Knox -- and obliterate the world's economy.

36643.title: The World Is Not Enough
36643.overview: Greed, revenge, world dominance and high-tech terrorism – it's all in a day's work for Bond, who's on a mission to protect a beautiful oil heiress from a notorious terrorist. In a race against time that culminates in a dramatic submarine showdown, Bond works to defuse the international power struggle that has the world's oil supply hanging in the balance.
